A hand gently pats her head. The setting shows a domestic interior with a chair and storage bins visible in the background. (4) The video concludes with a solid pink graphic screen featuring a small, centered cartoon illustration of the girl sitting down. Bold white text is displayed clearly below the graphic. The lighting is flat and uniform throughout this concluding sequence.
